overview_description.description: CARS24 offers a tech-enabled marketplace used for buying and selling pre-owned cars. It aims to revolutionize how used cars are sold by creating an efficient and reliable way for car owners to sell their used cars at a reasonable price. It utilizes an AI-enabled pricing algorithm that displays the accurate market price as well as the appraisal price of a vehicle. The platform also books appointments for vehicle inspection. The services provided by the company help customers sell their cars securely and efficiently.

about_short_description.short_description: CARS24 is as AutoTech company that utilizes technology and dealer network for buying and selling pre-owned cars.

product.name: Buy Used Cars
product.description: An online marketplace for purchasing pre-owned cars from CARS24, verified dealers, and individual sellers, with vehicle filters, listings, pricing information, inspections, and transaction support.

product.name: Sell Used Cars
product.description: A digital service for selling pre-owned cars through CARS24, including vehicle valuation, inspection, offer evaluation, documentation, and ownership-transfer support.

product.name: LOANS24 Used Car Loan
product.description: A financing service for purchasing used cars, offering eligibility checks, loan applications, flexible EMIs, competitive rates, and repayment tenures subject to borrower and lender approval.

product.name: Used Car Valuation
product.description: An online tool that estimates the market value of a pre-owned car to help owners assess a potential selling price before listing or selling it.

product.name: New Cars
product.description: An online research and discovery service for new cars, providing model information, comparisons, categories, pricing ranges, news, and reviews.

product.name: 300+ Point Car Inspection
product.description: A vehicle inspection service that assesses mechanical, safety, interior, and exterior conditions and provides an inspection report for used-car buyers and sellers.
